title: Ridership model
detail: Demand by station and line: boardings and alightings per station, line loads along each line, the peak load point, load factor against capacity, transfers at each station complex, trips per day and per year, passenger-km, mode share by corridor. Needs a demand source to be agreed with Ben: population and jobs by area (census tracts or the Sanborn blocks), a gravity or four-step model, or set figures per station.
